working: Per NCERT, DNA lies inside membranes, so cells must be broken open to release it. Lysozyme digests the bacterial cell wall, cellulase digests the plant cell wall and chitinase digests the fungal cell wall, so A is correct. R is also correct, since isolating genetic material requires disrupting cells. R explains why these enzymes are used, which points to option 1. This also matches my recollection of the answer key, though I am not certain of it.
